description.p: Tether shows your Android phone's notifications (and lets you reply), its text messages and calls on the computer, sends files both ways and shares the clipboard. It works over your home network, end-to-end encrypted with a key made when you pair the phone.
Bluetooth link when there is no Wi-Fi; relay fallback fixed.
Several computers per phone, a relay for away from Wi-Fi, a tray icon, phone self-updates.
A desktop layout, and Tether now runs in the background and starts with the computer.
First version: notifications, SMS, calls, files and clipboard.
